item.title: Storytelling Festival goes on despite weather
item.description: Some many years ago, members of the Brundidge Historical Society rode out a wind and rain storm for an hour or more. When the storm quieted, tents went back up, rubble was removed, animals were herded and the annual Peanut Butter Festival went on. On that very day, the officers of the Brundidge Historical Society declared that the show must go on. item.title: Local schools gear up for area basketball tournaments
item.description: Schedules set as Charles Henderson, Pike County and more open area basketball tournaments this week; see matchups, sites and tipoff times for girls and boys brackets.

item.title: Applications open for 2026-2027 Maggie J. Bryant Scholarship
item.description: Applications are open for the 2026-27 Maggie J. Bryant Scholarship, offering up to $1,500 to up to two students from Pike, Crenshaw or Covington counties; March deadline.

item.title: Troy University Libraries to host lecture series on Jewish history
item.description: Troy University Libraries will host a free public lecture series Feb. 16-19 on 4,000 years of Jewish history, led by Anne Frank Center CEO Dr. Lauren Bairnsfather at sites across Alabama.

item.title: Troy Football sings two more to Class of 2026
item.description: Troy football’s 2026 class grows again as the Trojans add three-star linebacker Jeremiah Roux and former Mississippi State tight end Jacorey Whitted to an already large group of signees.

item.title: Pike County native Matt Heffner gearing up for next fight
item.description: Pike County’s top-ranked amateur flyweight Matt Heffner puts his 9-0 record on the line Feb. 14 vs. 6-1 Emilio “The Mad Man” Barco at Tallahassee Combat Night.

item.title: Former Trojans Jones, Pettus set to live their dreams in Super Bowl
item.description: Former Troy Trojans Marcus Jones and Dell Pettus, now Patriots teammates, will face the Seahawks in Super Bowl LX after contributing on defense and special teams throughout 2025.

item.title: Pike County Relay for Life Pageant crowns 2026 winners
item.description: The ninth Pike County Relay for Life Pageant raised over $13,000 for the American Cancer Society and crowned 6-year-old Ellie Golden as Miss Spirit of Relay and Little Miss.
